title: Gravity Circuit - Trippin' On The Electric Floor ⚡ ~ Theme Of Cable - Power Circuit (Remix)
description:
Did a special birthday arrangement of Theme Of Cable - Power Circuit from Gravity Circuit.

WARNING: The following contains a hoodie getting obsessive over an indie platformer. Viewer discretion advised.
This... is... AAAAAAAAAAAAA!!! WORDS CANNOT EXPRESS HOW AMAZING THIS SONG IS!!! Dominic Ninmark (most known for his works on Mega Man X: Corrupted and now Gravity Circuit) is a living legend of a composer, and I am one of his MANY simps. Dude makes some absolute bangers. Dude was literally the reason why I even tried the demo out in the first place (and fell in love with it).

I highly recommend Gravity Circuit. It is quite literally one of the best indie games that we were given. We, as a society, do not deserve this game... WE, AS A SOCIETY, DO NOT DESERVE THIS MASTERPIECE OF ART!!!


Important:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ♠ "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ1. E Minor (Original Pitch) [turned on by default]
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ2. F Minor (Custom Pitch)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ1. Enables Voice Clip [turned on by default]
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ2. Disables Voice Clip
